title: Kwikset Tylo Passage Door Knob, Polished Brass - Open Box
categoryName: Home & Garden:Home Improvement:Building & Hardware:Doors & Door Hardware:Door Knobs & Levers
descriptionText:
Box is damaged but everything else is new. See pics.

Add a touch of elegance to your interior doors with the Kwikset Tylo Passage Door Knob. This polished brass knob has a round shape with a diameter of 2.5 inches and a height of 2.5 inches. It is suitable for use on interior room doors and comes with all the necessary hardware for easy installation. The Kwikset brand is known for its quality products and this knob is no exception. The gold color adds a touch of sophistication to any door and the finish is designed to last. Upgrade your doors with the Kwikset Tylo Passage Door Knob today!
